nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: How do climate-driven coral bleaching events impact marine diversity and human life?
nodes.answer: Coral bleaching events lead to mortality and reef degradation, which negatively affect marine diversity, ecosystem services, and human life.
nodes.subtopic: Role of ocean acidification in coral bleaching

nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What synergistic stressors may exacerbate coral bleaching beyond warming?
nodes.answer: Ocean acidification and local eutrophication are synergistic stressors that may further exacerbate coral bleaching.
nodes.subtopic: Role of ocean acidification in coral bleaching

nodes.id: Subtopic:Environment|Climate action|Ocean acidification|Role of ocean acidification in coral bleaching_qna_002
nodes.label: Science and tech
nodes.question: What could happen if algal symbiont populations do not recover quickly after a bleaching event?
nodes.answer: If algal symbiont populations do not recover within relatively short time periods, it may ultimately lead to mass coral mortality events.
